about: The models production runs, per tier, so the eval measures what users get (M33). Model ids, never keys. Each entry says where it was read from; refresh by reading the ledger (`ai_usage_steps.tier, model` and `ai_usage.classifier_model` on the production branch). Production's Vercel env holds these encrypted, so they are copied from what production actually ran, not from the dashboard. A null tier is one production has never run and nobody has confirmed: the runner refuses to guess it and names any turn that lands there.

strong.source: never run in production; AI_MODEL_STRONG is set there but encrypted
